title: Kozmos 2
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: After a broadcast on KAOS leaves Uzay missing without a trace, concern spreads among the students. Meanwhile, Melina struggles to process the shocking events she witnessed in the Secret Club, finding herself drawn deeper into Arın’s shadowed world. Toprak feels trapped between his distant brother Arın and their family, burdened by a secret he does not fully understand. As he navigates his relationship with Elsa and the emerging truths behind KAOS, the game becomes eerily real. When the next challenge begins, nothing will ever be the same again.
